name: Zebadiah
overview: Zebadiah was a male figure known as the son of Ishmael. He held a significant administrative role, being in charge of all matters pertaining to the king, as recorded in 2 Chronicles 19:11. There is no additional tribal affiliation or personal notes provided about him.
namesAndTitles: The name Zebadiah means 'YHWH bestows,' reflecting a theophoric element that acknowledges God's provision. This proper name is not indicated to have been given directly by God. The meaning highlights the belief in God's active role in granting blessings.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly records Zebadiah as the son of Ishmael, according to 2 Chronicles 19:11. No other family relationships are documented in the available information.
scriptureSignificance: Zebadiah's importance in the biblical narrative lies in his trusted position overseeing all that pertained to the king, indicating a role of considerable responsibility and influence in the royal administration. His lineage as the son of Ishmael connects him to a known biblical figure, which may underscore the continuity of leadership roles within certain families. His mention in 2 Chronicles 19:11 situates him within the historical governance context during the time of the kings of Judah.
